Success with Soul Affiliate

Partner Requirements

Welcome to the Success with Soul Affiliate Program! We’re thrilled to have you join us in empowering burned out, overwhelmed entrepreneurs. By promoting our products, you agree to the following terms:

 

Affiliate Responsibilities

  • Promotion: You will promote Success with Soul products using unique affiliate links provided to you. You may use your website, email, social media, and other approved channels.

  • Content: Ensure that all promotional content is accurate, honest, and compliant with applicable laws and regulations.

  • Disclosure: You agree to follow current FTC endorsement guidelines for disclosure when sharing affiliate links.

Commissions

  • Rate: You will earn a commission of 50% on all sales generated through your affiliate link, and 10% on any services and coaching offers. 

  • Payment: Commissions will be paid out monthly, on the 15th of each month, for the previous month’s sales, net 30 days. Payments are made via Bank Transfer to avoid fees. There is no minimum balance required for payout.

  • Refunds: Commissions on refunded products will be deducted from your earnings.

  • Chargebacks: Any commissions paid on sales that are later refunded due to chargebacks will be deducted from your future earnings.

  • Tracking Link: We will provide Affiliate with a unique tracking link to promote our programs. We will pay Affiliate a fee (hereinafter “Commission”) for each sale affiliated with your unique link. Tracking of these sales is automatically done by our marketing system, Kartra. You understand you will be paid only for sales tracked through our systems and associated with your link. Affiliate is solely responsible to make sure that they use the correct Affiliate link provided by Success with Soul, LLC when promoting the sale. Compensation is explicitly and exclusively tied to the proper use of the Affiliate link, and Affiliate will only be compensated for sales associated with that Affiliate link. Affiliate understands they will not be paid on sales they refer to themselves; no self-commissions are allowed. 

  • Dashboard: Affiliate will be granted access to an Affiliate dashboard on Kartra.com upon becoming an approved member of the Success with Soul, LLC Affiliate Program which will be unique to you and you only. This dashboard will provide you with ready-made Affiliate links containing your affiliate ID number

 

Terms and Termination

  • Duration: This agreement begins upon your acceptance into the affiliate program and continues until terminated by either party.

  • Termination: Either party may terminate this agreement at any time, with or without cause, by providing written notice. Upon termination, you will cease promoting our products and remove affiliate links and we will not be responsible for any future payouts. 

  • Modification: Success with Soul reserves the right to modify these terms at any time. Affiliates will be notified of any changes via email.

  • Promotional Materials: We may provide you graphics, email, web, or social copy, and other templates (hereinafter “Materials”) for you to use in the promotion of the products. The Materials may include design elements proprietary to Success with Soul, LLC. We grants you a revocable, non-exclusive license to use the Materials solely in relation to your efforts promoting the products under this Agreement. Distribution of Materials is prohibited.

  • Prohibited Activities

    • Misrepresentation: Do not misrepresent our products or make false claims.

    • Spam: Do not engage in any form of unsolicited commercial email (spam).

    • Trademark Use: Use of Success with Soul trademarks must be approved in writing.

 

Confidentiality

You agree to keep all confidential information, including commission details and marketing strategies, strictly confidential and not disclose it to any third parties.

 

Governing Law

This agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Georgia.

 

Independent Contractor

Nothing in this Agreement shall be construed to create a partnership, joint venture, employment, or agency relationship. You are an independent contractor and responsible for your own taxes.

 

Liability and Indemnification

You agree to absolve Success with Soul of any and all liability or loss incurred as a result of your participation in the affiliate program. You agree to indemnify and hold harmless Success with Soul, its officers, directors, employees, agents, and third parties for any losses, costs, liabilities, and expenses relating to or arising out of your promotion and participation as an affiliate.

 

Cookies

 

You are using Kartra’s affiliate platform to promote our products, sold by Success with Soul. Kartra is operating under their instruction and will only use your data in accordance with their wishes.

 

When you sign in to your affiliate dashboard, we use cookies to remember your details and allow you to view your statistics and access product resources.

 

We may need to contact you directly about important updates to the platform, for technical support, or for other reasons relating to our ability to provide your affiliate account. For more information on this, please visit our privacy policy.

 

When a customer clicks on your affiliate link, we will store a cookie on their computer to track that they have come to the checkout page through your link.

 

If the customer purchases, this cookie will identify them and will be used to attribute that sale to you.

 

We also pass on your affiliate ID to the URL that Success with Soul has set up. They may use this information themselves and for more details, you can contact them directly. 

 

Communication

 

You agree to keep a working email address for payments on file. It is not our responsibility to track down an Affiliate to make a payment. The Company will make reasonable attempts to pay the Affiliate for up to 6 months using the provided information. If the Company is unable to contact the Affiliate during this period through reasonable efforts, the Affiliate will forfeit any payments owed to them. Additionally, the Affiliate agrees to receive emails regarding this affiliate program.

 

Federal Trade Commission Disclosure

 

Affiliate agrees to follow current FTC endorsement guidelines for disclosure when sharing affiliate links. For more information, please refer to the FTC’s Revised Endorsement Guides: What People are Asking.

 

By joining our affiliate program, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to the terms outlined above.

 

Contact Information:

Success with Soul, LLC

Email: hi@successwithsoul.co

 

Thank you for partnering with us to spread the Success with Soul mission
